risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox with the engine, showing its condition and any visible damage or wear.

Photo of the engine with the hood open to show the engine bay and internal components.
Photo of the gearbox with the engine, showing its condition.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
